instruction_bn: নিয়ম মেনে আবেদনপত্র/formal letter লেখো। নিজে লেখার পর নমুনা ও checklist দেখো (Board: 10 marks)।

items.prompt: Write an application to the Headmaster of your school praying for leave of absence for three days as you are suffering from fever.
items.model:
Date: 10 May 2026

To
The Headmaster
[Name] High School, Dhaka

Subject: Prayer for leave of absence.

Sir,
With due respect, I beg to state that I am a student of class X in your school. I have been suffering from fever since last night. The doctor has advised me to take complete rest for three days. So, I am unable to attend my classes during this period.

I, therefore, pray and hope that you would be kind enough to grant me leave of absence for three days, from 10 to 12 May, and oblige thereby.

I remain,
Sir,
Your most obedient pupil,
Rahim Uddin
Class: X, Roll: 07
rubric: শেষে 'Your most obedient pupil' + নাম দিয়েছি

Sir,
We, the inhabitants of Shantipur village, beg to draw your kind attention to the fact that our area is a low-lying area. Every year during the rainy season it goes under water, and we suffer a lot for want of a safe place.

There is no flood shelter in our locality. If a flood shelter is built, people and cattle can take refuge there during the flood.

We, therefore, pray and hope that you would kindly take necessary steps to set up a flood shelter in our area and oblige thereby.

Yours faithfully,
The inhabitants of Shantipur village
